Your Parent’s Guide

Thanks for asking for the guide. It covers the 2026 to 27 season in England: what degree apprenticeships are, who pays, which schemes open when, what the application actually tests, and a month-by-month plan. Every number is sourced.

Download the guide

If you read one thing

There’s no single deadline. Each employer opens its own window, some only a few weeks long, and most big employers close early once they have enough applications. Pages 6 to 9 have the dates.

The most useful thing you can do this year is make sure each application goes in during the first fortnight of its window. That means being ready before it opens.
